g.text: — a chart of training cost can only ever plot the sliver of models that carry a cost.

g.text: Note: Share of the models in each release that carry a publication date and a value for the field. Coverage is far higher in the frontier

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: release because it is small and heavily researched, and lowest in the full database, which includes thousands of models nobody has

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: documented in depth. Nothing on this site fills these gaps: a model missing a field is dropped from that chart, which is why the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: plotted count differs from chart to chart and is stated on each one.
